applicableDomain: Versioned Clinical Form Templates, Structured Encounter Capture & Specialty KPI Dashboards
descriptionAndPurpose: Publishes versioned JSON Schema clinical intake/consultation forms (ANC, Pediatrics, NCD, OPD SOAP), validates structured responses bound to patientId and encounterId, and feeds real-time facility dashboards.
prerequisiteConditions: Published active template version and open encounterId.
safetyChecks: Mandatory clinical safety fields validated before signing.
Signed clinical form responses are versioned and never silently overwritten.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Retiring a template prevents new captures while preserving historical responses renderable under their original schema version.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs template publication, response submission, signature, and amendments.
completionCriteria: Structured clinical response validated, signed, and linked to encounterId.
